description: Hidden inputs and dev shortcuts. Tone must match the game (a horror game's debug menu reads different from a comedy's). Picked LAST — depends on everything.
prompt_template:
Given the full set of prior picks:
{prior_picks}

Generate {count} cheat/debug option sets. Each set is a coherent collection of 3-6 secret combos PLUS 2-4 debug menu items. Match the game's tone — match the dialog and visual style.

cheats: each entry has
  - combo: string ('up,up,down,down,a,b' or 'crank_full_clockwise_3x')
  - effect: string ('invincibility', 'skip_to_scene_5', etc)
  - mode: enum: debug_only | release_easter_egg | secret_ending_trigger

debug_menu_items: each entry has
  - title: short string (system menu item title)
  - action: string function name ('reset_save', 'skip_scene', 'fps_overlay')

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the cheats/debug option below per the user feedback. Adjust mode flags so release_easter_egg combos fit the game's tone.
